metadata.name: FlyWire female adult brain: annotation anchor sample
metadata.sampling: Deterministic per-class sample; Python Random(783); enriched for sensory and central circuits.
metadata.pointMeaning: Actual neuronal anchor points, not neuron morphologies, neuropil boundaries, or synapses.
metadata.groupMeaning: Broad annotation-derived circuit groups; neurons are not assigned solely by spatial position.
metadata.activityMeaning: Activity colors are outputs of an illustrative sensory/behavioral model, not recorded activity or a reconstructed synaptic simulation.
metadata.licenseNote: The pinned repository has no standalone data license file. Source attribution and publication citations are retained; no CC0 claim is made.

Neuronal wiring diagram of an adult brain

projection.coordinateConversion: Source anchor voxel coordinates multiplied by [0.004, 0.004, 0.04] micrometers.
